new_value: Chose the bead's fail-fast option (endpoint is currently UP — http://heft:4000/v1/models returns 200, so the 404 was likely path/model-specific; fail-fast works regardless of endpoint state). scripts/fanout.py: (1) describe_error() classifies failures: httpx.TransportError (ConnectError AND the TimeoutException family — the most likely failure class with timeout=300, previously stringifying EMPTY and printing 'ERROR: ReadTimeout: ') now names the endpoint + LITELLM_URL override using str(exc) or type(exc).__name__; HTTP 404 names POST {url}/chat/completions + LITELLM_URL/LITELLM_MODEL hints; other statuses reported with code; unknown exceptions pass through. (2) main(argv) accepts argv (repo convention, testable); raises SystemExit('all N agent calls failed against <url> (model: m)') when EVERY call fails — previously exited 0 silently; partial failure still exits 0 with per-agent diagnosed errors; --agents 0 guarded by 'results and' (reviewer caught the vacuous all-fail). (3) Fixed pre-existing ruff I001/E501 in the touched file. Tests: new scripts/test_fanout.py, 8 cases, no network (fanout/asyncio.run monkeypatched) — connect/timeout(empty-str)/404/other-status classification, zero-agents vacuous case, all-fail exit!=0, partial-failure exit 0 with mixed output. Suite 8/8 + scripts spinbead suite 14 passed; ruff clean. 3x review (kimi-k3): correctness found the vacuous all-fail + timeout gaps (both fixed, re-review PASS — TransportError hierarchy + str(exc)-or-classname verified against installed httpx 0.28.1), security+edge PASS (happy path byte-identical, SystemExit-1 semantics, LITELLM_KEY never printed, exception text to stderr acceptable given operator-set LITELLM_URL).
